rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Association of Puget Sound (MAPS) serves as a vital religious and social hub in the Pacific Northwest, providing a wide array of services ranging from daily prayers to specialized educational programs. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="1">$7,286,362 in total revenue</cite>, reflecting a <cite id="2">three-year revenue growth rate of 8.6%</cite>. The charity operates with high financial efficiency, maintaining a <cite id="3">program expense ratio of 81.7%</cite>, which ensures that the vast majority of donor contributions directly support community services rather than administrative overhead. Beyond its religious functions, MAPS facilitates significant social impact through its <cite id="4">Community Service (MAPS-MCRC)</cite> and <cite id="5">Small Business Resiliency Network</cite>. The organization demonstrates strong fiscal health, holding <cite id="6">17.3 months of working capital</cite> to ensure long-term stability. While primarily focused on the Puget Sound region, the organization's <cite id="7">PNW Seminary</cite> provides structured Islamic scholarship and leadership training for adults, filling a critical need for local religious education. Its operations are characterized by <cite id="8">direct service delivery</cite>, which contributes to a highly efficient <cite id="9">cost per beneficiary of approximately $90.84</cite>.
